scope: Source inspection and design only; no renderer3D implementation,mesh export or performance measurement

findings.observation: Named/default factory adapter returns concrete Pixi createCafeScene type; extract engine-neutral handle/options before adding3D.

Existing update,suspend,setReducedMotion,destroy and AbortSignal/ResizeObserver preserve viable integration points;3D GPU caches/mixers/imagebitmaps still need dedicated disposal/context-loss qualification.
sceneEntities/RoomSnapshot filter identity/context before interpolation; keep validated floor/seat IDs and motionPosition; rendering does not become authority.
Nearest-filtered32x48starter atlas and y-sorted sprites/Graphics interiors are pixel baseline, not3D mesh/fur/lighting evidence.
Existing starter-v1 palette/outfit schema; new cosmetic catalog needs additive authoritative validation and v1 projection under N06-07, not a local editor save.
Shared Next/Vite/Capacitor root has existing loader injection; Three/WebGL2 is a bounded candidate, no installed dependency or production renderer change yet.

proposedFloorMapping.mapping: server tile x,y -> world x,z; ground Y0,center offset0.5tile;3D height/seat/paw anchors cosmetic only
proposedFloorMapping.status: Design candidate; raycast/seat/floor equivalence must be tested in N06-11
